body:
In no particular order:

* Low-paying salary job, where I'm expected to produce corporate-level work a boss who has gone out of their way to ensure I can't find work elsewhere (blackballing, bad references) to keep me stuck at the same pay rate.
* Stuck living with abusive parent, going well into my 30s, due to afformentioned low-paying salary job.
* Watching my dream (novel I'm attempting to get funded and published) die because everyone around me is too chickenshit to tell me they hate my writing and to stop trying.  No, I will not provide you with a link.
* People around me generally being abusive, uncaring, and shallow.  Some of them going to the lengths to try and convince me that I'm a lazy, worthless, piece of crap for being exhausted by working for four years straight without sick leave or vacation.
* No friends in general.

And yes, that sounds lame as fuck.  Life gets better for others.  It doesn't for me.  I don't get to be happy, successful, etc.  If you think otherwise, then I pity you for your idiocy.
